premise.claim: "The current E2E workflow is monolithic and expensive: multiple jobs rebuild the same controller and CRD-upgrader images, repeat the same Kind/LWS/Helm setup, and run long suites sequentially."
premise.evidence: base workflow (798e5d6f) has 5 e2e jobs, each rebuilding/loading controller (+crd-upgrader except manifest) images and repeating Kind/LWS/Helm setup; the default job runs the 106-spec suite in one gulp — results/static-checks.txt, base-manifest-coverage.txt
